Keep your study moving

Include the app name, device and OS, app version and steps that caused the issue. Do not send passwords, verification codes or private study files.

Offline learning

Included questions, explanations, concepts, diagrams, review and study records are being verified for offline use. Purchases, redownloads, updates and external pages need an internet connection.

Records and deletion

Study records and A/B examples are stored on the device. Removing the app may remove those records. We do not promise cross-device synchronization or account recovery.

Notifications

Study reminders depend on device permissions and settings. Check both in-app and OS notification settings.

Report a question

Share the question identifier and the wording you want us to review. There is no need to send copies of official exam papers or personal information.
